title: feat(PROJ-1234): add goodbye + emphasize hello
impact_paragraph: Adds a goodbye() function alongside the existing hello() greeter and adjusts hello() to return 'world!' with an emphasis marker. Used by the welcome/farewell middleware in the session lifecycle. No config flag; behavior is unconditional.
why_it_matters: Closes PROJ-1234 (UX consistency between session enter and exit messages)
No production risk: pure-function additions, no I/O, no DB
